output.title: Signature algorithm customization: scope and default behaviour not stated
output.content: The release note only says "Allow customizing signature algorithm" (#7591). It doesn't say which resource or field the option lives on, or whether anything changes for setups that don't use it. The environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, so the area this feature touches is in use. Nothing in the inputs shows a related setting being used or needed, so it can't be decided whether the change matters here. To settle it, read PR #7591 and check whether the new option is on Certificate resources or elsewhere, and whether certificates that don't set it keep their current signature algorithm.
